inputs.text:
A flat minimalist 2D illustration of a single object of [INGREDIENT].
The object is shown at a fixed three-quarter view, rotated approximately 35 degrees to the right.
Strictly non-realistic, non-photographic, no depth realism.

Graphic shape-based illustration, strong simplified silhouette.
The object is constructed from large, clean color shapes with very limited internal detail.
No visible texture, no skin pores, no gradients simulating realism.

Dark but muted pastel color palette.
Low contrast overall, soft tonal transitions.
Color harmony inspired by dark academia and storybook illustration.
Subtle occult or magical mood suggested only through color balance and abstract form, not symbols.

Flat lighting, no light source.
No shadows (no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion).
No highlights, no reflections.

2D illustration only, absolutely no 3D appearance.
No painterly brush strokes, no sketch lines.
Clean vector-like edges, slightly organic but controlled line quality.

Centered composition.
Single object only.
Isolated on a flat neutral background or transparent background.
No environment, no surface, no horizon line.

Cozy, calm, mysterious, understated mood.
Children’s storybook meets minimalist editorial illustration.

Ultra-consistent framing and proportions.
No text, no logos, no watermark.
